content.text: The warranty package meets our preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 satisfies the preferred position. 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 warrants each Deliverable for ninety days after the later of delivery or acceptance and warrants hosted Services conformity for the entire subscription term (better than the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law, no malicious code, no functionality reduction and open-source protection. 19.4 supplies the required remedy ladder of re-performance, repair or replacement with termination and refund of Fees if Vendor cannot cure, and expressly preserves other remedies. 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or other stated remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. Acceptance mechanics in 6.1–6.2 (no deemed acceptance, correction cycles, refund on repeated failure) reinforce the warranty. No customer-adverse gap warrants an edit.
